text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look at this, Grass!
Such a powerful, wrestler-like physique!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right.
You have been working really hard on your muscle training lately, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí!
My body is shaping up nicely, yeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To get faster,
it is also important to train your body, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm glad to see that
El's diet seems to be going well.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
D-D-Dieting...? No way, nothing like that,
not at all... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Right. There's no way someone would gain weight
from eating too many limited-edition omelets, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oops, it's about time for my diet... I mean, my muscle training! Excuse me, pleeease!

After devoting herself to her diet...
or rather, muscle training, El Condor Pasa
successfully managed to shed the weight.
